## Missing Data Analysis

```{r}
#define a function to analyze missing data
analyze_suppression <- function(data,
                                sex_var = "sex",
                                age_var = "age_group",
                                geo_var = "geo",
                                time_var = "time") {

  summary_df <- data %>%
    mutate(is_suppressed = Deaths == "Suppressed") %>%
    group_by(across(all_of(c(sex_var, age_var, geo_var)))) %>%  
    summarise(
      n_total        = n(),
      n_suppressed   = sum(is_suppressed, na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_suppressed = 100 * n_suppressed / n_total,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  age_levels <- summary_df %>%
    distinct(!!sym(age_var)) %>%
    mutate(
      num_start = as.numeric(str_extract(!!sym(age_var), "\\d+")),
      num_start = ifelse(grepl("^< ?1", !!sym(age_var)), -1, num_start)
    ) %>%
    arrange(num_start) %>%
    pull(!!sym(age_var))

  summary_df <- summary_df %>%
    mutate(
      !!age_var := factor(.data[[age_var]], levels = age_levels),
      !!geo_var := factor(.data[[geo_var]], levels = sort(unique(.data[[geo_var]])))
    )

  ## ---------- heatmap with male/female layers ----------

  has_male   <- any(summary_df[[sex_var]] == "Male",   na.rm = TRUE)
  has_female <- any(summary_df[[sex_var]] == "Female", na.rm = TRUE)

  p <- ggplot()

  # male (blue)
  if (has_male) {
    p <- p +
      geom_tile(
        data = summary_df %>% filter(.data[[sex_var]] == "Male"),
        aes(x = .data[[geo_var]],
            y = .data[[age_var]],
            fill = pct_suppressed),
        color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colors = c("#e0faff", "#80e0ff", "#26b4f0", "#007acc", "#004c99"),
        limits = c(0, 100),
        breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
  labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
        name   = "Male",
        guide  = guide_colorbar(
          barwidth  = unit(4, "cm"),
          barheight = unit(0.45, "cm"),
          title.position = "top"
        )
      )
  }

  # allow second scale only if both sexes exist
  if (has_male && has_female) p <- p + ggnewscale::new_scale("fill")

  # female (pink)
  if (has_female) {
    p <- p +
      geom_tile(
        data = summary_df %>% filter(.data[[sex_var]] == "Female"),
        aes(x = .data[[geo_var]],
            y = .data[[age_var]],
            fill = pct_suppressed),
        color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.3
      ) +
      scale_fill_gradientn(
        colors = c("#ffe6f2", "#ffb3d9", "#ff80bf", "#ff4da6", "#cc0077"),
        limits = c(0, 100),
        breaks = c(0, 25, 50, 75, 100),
  labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1),
        name   = "Female",
        guide  = guide_colorbar(
          barwidth  = unit(4, "cm"),
          barheight = unit(0.45, "cm"),
          title.position = "top"
        )
      )
  }

  heatmap_plot <- p +
    facet_wrap(as.formula(paste("~", sex_var))) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      title = "Suppression Heatmap by Sex, Age, and Geography",
      x = "Geography",
      y = "Age Group"
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      legend.box = "horizontal",
      legend.spacing.x = unit(1.2, "cm"),     # ← gives spacing between bars
      panel.grid = element_blank()
    )


  # overall suppression over time if a valid time_var is given
  if (!is.null(time_var) && time_var %in% names(data)) {
    time_df <- data %>%
      mutate(is_suppressed = Deaths == "Suppressed") %>%
      group_by(.data[[time_var]]) %>%
      summarise(
        pct_suppressed = 100 * mean(is_suppressed, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      arrange(.data[[time_var]])

    line_plot <- ggplot(time_df, aes(x = .data[[time_var]], y = pct_suppressed)) +
      geom_line(color = "#4c5fd7", linewidth = 1) +
      geom_point(color = "#4c5fd7", size = 1.5) +
      theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
      labs(
        title = "Overall Suppression Over Time",
        x = time_var,
        y = "% Suppressed"
      ) +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1, size = 2),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
      )
  } else {
    time_df   <- NULL
    line_plot <- NULL
  }

  list(summary = summary_df, heatmap = heatmap_plot, line = line_plot)
}
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
# suppression in original data
make_suppression_plot <- function(dataset_orig,
                                  dataset_inf,
                                  sex_var,
                                  age_var_orig,
                                  age_var_inf,
                                  geo_var,
                                  time_var = "Month",
                                  plot_title = "") {

supp_orig <- analyze_suppression(
  dataset_orig,
  sex_var = sex_var,
  age_var = age_var_orig,
  geo_var = geo_var,
  time_var = time_var
)

# suppression in inferred data
supp_inf <- analyze_suppression(
  dataset_inf,
  sex_var = sex_var,
  age_var = age_var_inf,
  geo_var = geo_var,
  time_var = time_var
)

# show heatmaps side by side
p1 <- supp_orig$heatmap + ggtitle("Suppression Heatmap – Original Data", subtitle = plot_title)  + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank(), 
                                                                                                         legend.position = "none",
                                                                                                         strip.text = element_text(size = 14),
                                                                                                         axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
                                                                                                         )
p2 <- supp_inf$heatmap + ggtitle("Suppression Heatmap – Inferred Data", subtitle = plot_title) + theme(axis.title.x   = element_blank(), 
                                                                                                       legend.position = "none",
                                                                                                       strip.text = element_text(size = 14), 
                                                                                                       axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12)
                                                                                                       ) 

p_for_legend <- supp_orig$heatmap +
  ggtitle("Suppr. Heatmap – Original Data") +
  theme(
    axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p_for_legend)

top_row <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  p1, p2,
  nrow = 1,
  align = "hv"
)

geo_row <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_grob(
    grid::textGrob(
      "Census Region",
      gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 16),
      x  = 0.5,
      hjust = 0.5
    )
  )

legend_row <- cowplot::ggdraw() +
  cowplot::draw_grob(legend) +
  theme(plot.margin = margin(t = 5, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10))

final_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
  top_row,
  geo_row,
  legend_row,
  ncol = 1,
  rel_heights = c(4, 0.5, 0.5)  
)

final_plot
}
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
dataset_reg_5 <- read.csv("../data/missing_data/data_for_infer/WONDER-Sex-5Yr-Census-Region-Clean.csv",

  mutate(
    Deaths = trimws(Deaths),
    Sex = dplyr::recode(Sex.Code,
                        "F" = "Female",
                        "M" = "Male"),
    Census.Region = stringr::str_replace(Census.Region, "^Census Region \\d+:\\s*", "")
  )

plot_reg_5yr <- make_suppression_plot(
  dataset_orig = dataset_reg_5,
  dataset_inf  = inferred_reg_5,
  sex_var      = "Sex",
  age_var_orig = "Five.Year.Age.Groups",
  age_var_inf  = "Age.Groups",
  geo_var      = "Census.Region",
  time_var     = "Month.Code"
)

plot_reg_5yr
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
## ---------- 5-year Census Division ----------
division_lookup <- read.csv(
  "../data/missing_data/Census-Division_Code.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

dataset_div_5 <- read.csv(
  "../data/missing_data/data_for_infer/WONDER-5Yr-Census-Division-Sex-Clean.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    Deaths   = trimws(Deaths),
    Sex      = dplyr::recode(Sex.Code,
                             "F" = "Female",
                             "M" = "Male"),
    AgeGroup = Age.Group.Code,
    Month    = Month.Code
  ) |>
  left_join(
    division_lookup,
    by = "Census.Division.Code"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    Geo = Census.Division
  ) |>
  select(Sex, AgeGroup, Geo, Month, Deaths)


inferred_div_5 <- read.csv(
  "../data/missing_data/Inferred-WONDER-Census Division-Sex-5Yr.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
) |>
  mutate(
    Deaths   = trimws(Deaths),
    Sex      = dplyr::recode(Sex.Code, "F" = "Female", "M" = "Male"),
    AgeGroup = Age.Groups,
    Geo      = Census.Division,
    Month    = Month.Code
  ) |>
  select(Sex, AgeGroup, Geo, Month, Deaths)


plot_div_5yr <- make_suppression_plot(
  dataset_orig = dataset_div_5,
  dataset_inf  = inferred_div_5,
  sex_var      = "Sex",
  age_var_orig = "AgeGroup",
  age_var_inf  = "AgeGroup",
  geo_var      = "Geo",
  time_var     = "Month",
  plot_title   = "Census Division – 5-Year Age Groups"
)
```

# Demographic Analysis
```{r}
#using hmd for population distribution

US_data <- hmd.mx(country="USA", username="amandahuang@ucsb.edu", password="Ilovepstat296!")
US_data99 <- extract.years(US_data, 1995:2020)

female_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(US_data99$pop$female))
colnames(female_df) <- c("Age", "Year", "Exposure")
female_df$Sex <- "Female"

male_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(US_data99$pop$male))
colnames(male_df) <- c("Age", "Year", "Exposure")
male_df$Sex <- "Male"

total_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(US_data99$pop$total))
colnames(total_df) <- c("Age", "Year", "Exposure")
total_df$Sex <- "Total"

usa_exposure_df <- bind_rows(female_df, male_df, total_df) %>%
  mutate(
    Age  = as.numeric(as.character(Age)),
    Year = as.numeric(as.character(Year))
  )

age_order_5 <- c(
  "< 1 year","1-4 years","5-9 years","10-14 years","15-19 years",
  "20-24 years","25-29 years","30-34 years","35-39 years","40-44 years",
  "45-49 years","50-54 years","55-59 years","60-64 years","65-69 years",
  "70-74 years","75-79 years","80-84 years","85-89 years","90-94 years",
  "95-99 years","100+ years"
)

hmd_5yr <- usa_exposure_df %>%
  filter(Sex %in% c("Male", "Female")) %>%   #removes total
  mutate(
    Five.Year.Age.Groups = dplyr::case_when(
      Age == 0                      ~ "< 1 year",
      Age >= 1   & Age <= 4         ~ "1-4 years",
      Age >= 5   & Age <= 9         ~ "5-9 years",
      Age >= 10  & Age <= 14        ~ "10-14 years",
      Age >= 15  & Age <= 19        ~ "15-19 years",
      Age >= 20  & Age <= 24        ~ "20-24 years",
      Age >= 25  & Age <= 29        ~ "25-29 years",
      Age >= 30  & Age <= 34        ~ "30-34 years",
      Age >= 35  & Age <= 39        ~ "35-39 years",
      Age >= 40  & Age <= 44        ~ "40-44 years",
      Age >= 45  & Age <= 49        ~ "45-49 years",
      Age >= 50  & Age <= 54        ~ "50-54 years",
      Age >= 55  & Age <= 59        ~ "55-59 years",
      Age >= 60  & Age <= 64        ~ "60-64 years",
      Age >= 65  & Age <= 69        ~ "65-69 years",
      Age >= 70  & Age <= 74        ~ "70-74 years",
      Age >= 75  & Age <= 79        ~ "75-79 years",
      Age >= 80  & Age <= 84        ~ "80-84 years",
      Age >= 85  & Age <= 89        ~ "85-89 years",
      Age >= 90  & Age <= 94        ~ "90-94 years",
      Age >= 95  & Age <= 99        ~ "95-99 years",
      Age >= 100                    ~ "100+ years",
      TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Five.Year.Age.Groups)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Five.Year.Age.Groups, Sex) %>%
  summarise(Exposure = sum(Exposure, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Five.Year.Age.Groups = factor(Five.Year.Age.Groups, levels = age_order_5)
  )
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
expo_max  <- max(hmd_5yr$Exposure, na.rm = TRUE)
expo_max  <- ceiling(expo_max / 1e6) * 1e6   # nicer round value

expo_breaks <- c(-expo_max, -expo_max/2, 0, expo_max/2, expo_max)

age_levels_5 <- levels(hmd_5yr$Five.Year.Age.Groups)

band_start <- which(age_levels_5 == "25-29 years") - 0.5
band_end   <- which(age_levels_5 == "60-64 years") + 0.5

p_expo <- hmd_5yr %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2000, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    ExposurePlot = ifelse(Sex == "Male", -Exposure, Exposure),
    Five.Year.Age.Groups = factor(Five.Year.Age.Groups, levels = age_order_5),
    Year = factor(Year, levels = c(2000, 2010, 2020))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Five.Year.Age.Groups, y = ExposurePlot, fill = Sex)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = "25-29 years",
    xmax = "65-69 years",
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "black",
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(-expo_max, expo_max),
                    breaks = expo_breaks,
                    labels = function(x) scales::comma(abs(x))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = "#007acc", "Female" = "#ff8ab8")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Year, nrow = 1) +  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "U.S. Population Pyramids (2000, 2010, 2020)",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Exposure (person-years)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 12)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 18)),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.25, "lines"),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(40, "pt"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(12, "pt"), 
  )

p_expo
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
US_mort_M <- StMoMoData(US_data99, series = "male",   type = "central")
US_mort_F <- StMoMoData(US_data99, series = "female", type = "central")


make_deaths_df <- function(x, sex_label) {
  as.data.frame(as.table(x$Dxt)) %>%
    rename(
      Age    = Var1,
      Year   = Var2,
      Deaths = Freq
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Age  = as.numeric(as.character(Age)),
      Year = as.numeric(as.character(Year)),
      Sex  = sex_label
    )
}

deaths_M <- make_deaths_df(US_mort_M, "Male")
deaths_F <- make_deaths_df(US_mort_F, "Female")

deaths_all <- bind_rows(deaths_M, deaths_F)

deaths_5yr_sex <- deaths_all %>%
  mutate(
    Five.Year.Age.Groups = dplyr::case_when(
      Age == 0                      ~ "< 1 year",
      Age >= 1   & Age <= 4         ~ "1-4 years",
      Age >= 5   & Age <= 9         ~ "5-9 years",
      Age >= 10  & Age <= 14        ~ "10-14 years",
      Age >= 15  & Age <= 19        ~ "15-19 years",
      Age >= 20  & Age <= 24        ~ "20-24 years",
      Age >= 25  & Age <= 29        ~ "25-29 years",
      Age >= 30  & Age <= 34        ~ "30-34 years",
      Age >= 35  & Age <= 39        ~ "35-39 years",
      Age >= 40  & Age <= 44        ~ "40-44 years",
      Age >= 45  & Age <= 49        ~ "45-49 years",
      Age >= 50  & Age <= 54        ~ "50-54 years",
      Age >= 55  & Age <= 59        ~ "55-59 years",
      Age >= 60  & Age <= 64        ~ "60-64 years",
      Age >= 65  & Age <= 69        ~ "65-69 years",
      Age >= 70  & Age <= 74        ~ "70-74 years",
      Age >= 75  & Age <= 79        ~ "75-79 years",
      Age >= 80  & Age <= 84        ~ "80-84 years",
      Age >= 85  & Age <= 89        ~ "85-89 years",
      Age >= 90  & Age <= 94        ~ "90-94 years",
      Age >= 95  & Age <= 99        ~ "95-99 years",
      Age >= 100                    ~ "100+ years",
      TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Five.Year.Age.Groups)) %>%
  group_by(Year, Five.Year.Age.Groups, Sex) %>%
  summarise(Deaths = sum(Deaths, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(
    Five.Year.Age.Groups = factor(
      Five.Year.Age.Groups,
      levels = c(
        "< 1 year","1-4 years","5-9 years","10-14 years","15-19 years",
        "20-24 years","25-29 years","30-34 years","35-39 years","40-44 years",
        "45-49 years","50-54 years","55-59 years","60-64 years","65-69 years",
        "70-74 years","75-79 years","80-84 years","85-89 years","90-94 years",
        "95-99 years","100+ years"
      )
    )
  )

death_max <- max(deaths_5yr_sex$Deaths, na.rm = TRUE)
death_max <- ceiling(death_max / 1e5) * 1e5
death_breaks <- c(-death_max, -death_max/2, 0, death_max/2, death_max)

p_deaths <- deaths_5yr_sex %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2000, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex        = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    DeathsPlot = ifelse(Sex == "Male", -Deaths, Deaths),
    Five.Year.Age.Groups = factor(Five.Year.Age.Groups, levels = age_order_5),
    Year       = factor(Year, levels = c(2000, 2010, 2020))
  ) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Five.Year.Age.Groups, y = DeathsPlot, fill = Sex)) +
  
  # --- bars first ---
  geom_col(width = 0.9) +
  
  # --- highlight band for ages 25–69 ---
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = "25-29 years",
    xmax = "65-69 years",
    ymin = -Inf,
    ymax = Inf,
    fill = "black",
    alpha = 0.12
  ) +
  
  coord_flip() +
  
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-death_max, death_max),
    breaks = death_breaks,
    labels = function(x) scales::comma(abs(x))
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = "#007acc", "Female" = "#ff8ab8")) +
  
  facet_wrap(~ Year, nrow = 1) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "U.S. Deaths by Age Group and Sex (2000, 2010, 2020)",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Deaths"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 10, margin = margin(r = 12)),
    axis.title.y    = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(r = 18)),
    axis.title.x    = element_text(size = 12, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    panel.spacing   = unit(1.25, "lines"),
    plot.margin     = margin(5, 5, 5, 5),
    panel.spacing.x = unit(40, "pt"),
    panel.spacing.y = unit(12, "pt")
  )

p_deaths
```

```{r}
age_levels <- levels(deaths_5yr_sex$Five.Year.Age.Groups)

expo_df <- hmd_5yr %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2000, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    ExposurePlot = ifelse(Sex == "Male", -Exposure, Exposure),
    Year         = factor(Year, levels = c(2000, 2010, 2020))
  )

# deaths (StMoMo) for overlay
deaths_df <- deaths_5yr_sex %>%
  filter(Year %in% c(2000, 2010, 2020)) %>%
  mutate(
    Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("Male", "Female")),
    DeathsPlot = ifelse(Sex == "Male", -Deaths, Deaths),
    Year       = factor(Year, levels = c(2000, 2010, 2020))
  )

# compute one scaling factor for all years
scale_factor <- max(abs(expo_df$ExposurePlot), na.rm = TRUE) /
                max(abs(deaths_df$DeathsPlot),  na.rm = TRUE)

# apply scaling
deaths_df <- deaths_df %>%
  mutate(DeathsPlot_scaled = DeathsPlot * scale_factor)
```

```{r, fig.width = 12, fig.height = 6}
### overlayed

ggplot() +
  geom_col(
    data = expo_df,
    aes(x = Five.Year.Age.Groups, y = ExposurePlot, fill = Sex),
    width = 0.9,
    alpha = 0.30
  ) +
  geom_col(
    data = deaths_df,
    aes(x = Five.Year.Age.Groups, y = DeathsPlot_scaled, fill = Sex),
    width = 0.55,
    alpha = 0.95
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = function(x) scales::comma(abs(x))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Male" = "#007acc", "Female" = "#ff8ab8")) +
  facet_wrap(~ Year, nrow = 1) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Exposure (faded) and Deaths (rescaled solid)\nU.S. Population (2000, 2010, 2020)",
    x = "Age Group",
    y = "Count (deaths rescaled for visibility)"
  ) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    strip.text    = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines")
  )
```

# Exploratory Data Analysis

## Census Region

```{r}
census_region <- read.csv("../data/wonder_opioid/Census-Region.csv") %>%
  filter(Year != 'NA')
```

```{r} 
#shira added (temp)
census_region <- census_region %>%
  mutate(
    Population_num = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", Population))
  )

pop_region <- census_region %>%
  group_by(Census.Region) %>%
  summarise(TotalPop = sum(Population_num, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

ggplot(pop_region, aes(x = reorder(Census.Region, -TotalPop), y = TotalPop)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#007acc") +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Total Population by Census Region",
       x = "Census Region", y = "Total Population") +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

ggplot(census_region, aes(x = Year, y = Population_num, color = Census.Region)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.9) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Population by Census Region Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Population"
  )

pop_region <- pop_region %>%
  mutate(share = 100 * TotalPop / sum(TotalPop))

ggplot(pop_region, aes(x = "", y = share, fill = Census.Region)) +
  geom_col(width = 1, color = "white") +
  coord_polar(theta = "y") +
  theme_void() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Blues") +
  labs(title = "Share of Total U.S. Population by Census Region", fill = "Region")

```

## Five Year Age Group

```{r}
age_order <- c("< 1 year","1-4 years","5-9 years","10-14 years","15-19 years","20-24 years","25-29 years","30-34 years","35-39 years","40-44 years","45-49 years","50-54 years","55-59 years","60-64 years ","65-69 years","70-74 years","75-79 years","80-84 years","85-89 years", "90-94 years", "95-99 years", "100+ years")
five_year <- read.csv("../data/wonder_opioid/Five-Year-Age-Group.csv") %>%
  filter(!Year %in% c(NA,1999),
         !Crude.Rate %in% c("Unreliable","Suppressed","Not Applicable"),
         !Five.Year.Age.Groups %in% c("< 1 year","1-4 years","5-9 years","10-14 years","80-84 years","85-89 years", "90-94 years", "95-99 years", "100+ years",NA)) %>%
  filter(!Crude.Rate %in% c("Unreliable","Suppressed","Not Applicable")) %>%
  mutate(Crude.Rate = as.numeric(Crude.Rate),
         Crude.Lower = as.numeric(Crude.Rate.Lower.95..Confidence.Interval),
         Crude.Upper = as.numeric(Crude.Rate.Upper.95..Confidence.Interval),
```
